Why Choose a Limo Service in Scottsdale?

Scottsdale is known for its upscale lifestyle, world-class resorts, and vibrant nightlife. A professional limo service complements this atmosphere perfectly, offering:

  • Professional chauffeurs trained in local routes and hospitality
  • Climate-controlled vehicles essential for Arizona summers
  • Complimentary amenities including water, WiFi, and phone chargers
  • Door-to-door service eliminating parking hassles

Popular Occasions for Limo Service

Weddings

Our Chrysler Limo seats 8, and the Pink Hummer Limo seats 18. Ask about decoration and anything else you would like arranged when you book; what is included is set out in your written quote.

Scottsdale Nightlife

Hit Old Town Scottsdale's best clubs and bars without worrying about designated drivers. The Pink Hummer Limo seats 18 and the Party Bus (28 Pax) seats 28.

Corporate Events

Impress clients with the Luxury SUV (Suburban) for up to 6, or coordinate group transportation for conferences at the Scottsdale Convention Center.

Airport Transfers

Skip the rental car hassle with door-to-door service from Phoenix Sky Harbor (PHX) to any Scottsdale destination.

Pricing Guide

Scottsdale limo service pricing typically ranges from:

  • Luxury SUV (Suburban), 6 seats: $125/hour
  • Chrysler Limo, 8 seats: $150/hour
  • Pink Hummer Limo, 18 seats: $295/hour
  • Party Bus (28 Pax), 28 seats: $250/hour

All figures before tax.

For hourly charters, every vehicle has a four-hour minimum, except the 56-Passenger Motorcoach at five. Airport transfers are a separate flat fare. The rate is the same every day of the week.

Tips for Booking

  1. Book early - Weekend dates fill up 2-4 weeks in advance
  2. Confirm the headcount - Vehicle capacity affects pricing
  3. Discuss the itinerary - Multiple stops may incur additional fees
  4. Ask about gratuity - Typically 18-20% is standard
  5. Review the contract - Understand cancellation policies

What Sets Premium Services Apart

Look for companies that offer:

  • Licensed and insured operations
  • Well-maintained, late-model vehicles
  • Professional, uniformed chauffeurs
  • Real-time trip tracking
  • 24/7 customer support
